selection.partnerPolicy: Same calibration speaker; another parent utterance and different lexical syllable; deterministic SHA order. Both sources have unanimous expert correctness.

cases.noise: Seeded NumPy PCG64 white noise; scale using whole-clip speech RMS and prescribed SNR; normalize joint peak to0.8; preserve pre-PCM SNR and seed.
cases.nonWavPayloadUtf8: Love Pinyin explicit invalid-audio stress fixture

counting.unit: Actual payload SHA256; all target queries for that waveform are combined and any unsafe result fails the waveform once.
counting.twoSyllableTargets: Query both constituent known targets; either matched counts one waveform failure.
counting.missingResult: unavailable and retained in the complete denominator
counting.duplicatePayloads: Retain every planned case/query, report duplicate payloads, do not count repeated silence or invalid bytes as independent waveforms.
counting.confidenceIntervals: Wilson95 per-waveform descriptive intervals; derived siblings and eight calibration speakers are correlated; no final population or child claim.

constraints: Never read frozen test items or audio.
The protocol selects public real speech using original expert votes, not model agreement or synthetic expected text.
Concatenation is a derived multi-syllable structural challenge, not newly recorded natural connected speech.
Silence and contaminated or invalid audio are unassessable inputs; do not label them child pronunciation errors.
Do not modify model weights, thresholds, coverage or signal guards during stress evaluation.
Freeze source manifest, complete package metadata and protocol hashes in every preparation and result.
